:::{#exr-row-space-practice}
#### Testing whether a vector is in a row space

The [row space](#def-row-space) of a [matrix](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-matrix) $\matr{A}$ is the [column space](#def-column-space) of its [transpose](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-matrix-transpose).
Let

$$
\matr{A} = \sbmat{1 & 2 \\ 3 & 6}
$$

and let $\vecf{v}$ be the [column vector](linear-algebra-vectors.qmd#def-column-vector) $(1, 2)$.

Decide whether $\vecf{v}$ is in the row space $\mathcal{C}(\tp{\matr{A}})$.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Write out $\tp{\matr{A}}$ and look for $\vecf{u}$ with $\tp{\matr{A}}\vecf{u} = \vecf{v}$.

:::

:::
